discovery: Discovery of glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) and development of GLP-1-based therapies for diabetes and obesity
rationale: GLP-1 biology moved from basic hormone discovery to transformative treatments for type 2 diabetes and obesity. The work has already won the Lasker (2024), Breakthrough and Gairdner prizes, and with the 2024-2025 Medicine prizes going to RNA and immune-tolerance research, a metabolic or clinical-translation topic is due.
